name: NAD+ metabolism via tryptophan-kynurenine pathway
rationale: All members concern NAD+ precursor metabolism (nicotinate, salvage, NAD+ breakdown, tryptophan-kynurenine-quinolinate route); the de novo tryptophan/kynurenine arm is what the NADP/CoA/pyruvate and polyamine confusables lack.

qualifier: ATF6, XBP1 and ATF4 transcriptional arms
name: ER unfolded protein response via ATF6, XBP1 and ATF4
rationale: Members are ER-stress UPR signalling and its control of beta-cell and ER-stress apoptosis; the ATF6/CREB3, XBP1 and ATF4 chaperone gene activation distinguishes it from confusables centred on eIF2alpha kinases, mitochondrial UPR and translational control.

core: GPCR regulation of endocrine hormone secretion
name: Incretin, glucagon and nutrient GPCR hormone secretion signaling
rationale: Members are G protein-coupled receptor signals (GLP-1, GIP, glucagon-type, FFAR, HCA, somatostatin, muscarinic) controlling insulin and other hormone secretion via adenylate cyclase; the incretin/glucagon-type receptor and stimulatory cAMP side distinguishes it from beta-cell glucose sensing, ghrelin and adrenergic/PKA-inhibition confusables.

qualifier: dolichol and mannose donor supply defects
name: Congenital N-glycosylation disorders of dolichol and mannose donor supply
rationale: All members are type I CDGs caused by defects in dolichol synthesis/phosphorylation, mannose-donor provision and use, or LLO flipping (SRD5A3, DOLK, PMM2, MPDU1, RFT1), unlike the ALG glycosyltransferase CDGs and DPM/MPI/PGM1 confusables.

name: Osteoclast-driven bone remodeling and mineralization regulation
rationale: Members regulate bone turnover through osteoclast differentiation, fusion, proliferation and resorption plus bone mineralization; the osteoclast/mineralization focus separates it from osteoblast-differentiation and IGF-response confusables.

name: Golgi ribbon and stack structural remodeling
rationale: All members concern assembly, disassembly and reorganization of the Golgi ribbon and cisternal stacks, whereas confusables are COPI and Golgi vesicle trafficking.

name: Sema3A repulsion and axon collateral sprouting control
rationale: Members cover regulation of collateral sprouting, nerve branching and projection regrowth together with Sema3A-plexin/CRMP repulsion and microtubule restraint; this Sema3A and sprouting combination is absent from netrin, ephrin and regeneration confusables.

core: Class I cytokine receptor JAK-STAT signaling
qualifier: growth hormone, prolactin, leptin and gp130 cytokines
name: Growth hormone, prolactin, leptin and gp130 cytokine JAK-STAT signaling
rationale: Members are JAK-STAT cytokine-receptor signalling by GH, prolactin, leptin, IL-6 family (LIF, CNTF, IL-11) and thrombopoietin with organism growth control; this receptor set distinguishes it from erythropoietin, thyroid hormone and GH-secretion confusables.

qualifier: pyruvate dehydrogenase complex and its regulation
name: Pyruvate dehydrogenase complex activity and regulation
rationale: All members describe PDH-catalysed decarboxylation of pyruvate to acetyl-CoA and its regulation, distinct from the other 2-oxoacid dehydrogenases, TCA cycle and malate-aspartate shuttle confusables.

qualifier: SLIT-ROBO signaling at midline and optic pathway
name: SLIT-ROBO axon guidance at midline and optic pathway
rationale: Members are Roundabout/SLIT signalling and its Rho-GTPase effectors in commissural midline crossing and retinal ganglion cell/optic nerve guidance, which the netrin, ephrin and L1 guidance confusables lack.

name: Complement C3 and C5 activation and opsonization
rationale: Members centre on C3/C5 convertase activation (including the GZMK route) and opsonization within the complement system, whereas confusables are the classical and alternative initiating pathways and cascade regulation.

qualifier: mRNA stability/decay and small RNA silencing
name: Post-transcriptional control by mRNA decay and small RNAs
rationale: Members regulate gene output after transcription via ARE-binding stability factors, deadenylation/decapping decay, miRNA/siRNA biogenesis and silencing, and splicing/translation modulation; this regulatory mRNA turnover and small-RNA focus separates it from nuclear 3'-end processing, splicing machinery and maternal mRNA clearance confusables.

qualifier: GABA reuptake and synaptic vesicle loading
name: GABA uptake and synaptic vesicle neurotransmitter loading
rationale: Members are SLC-mediated GABA (and related sulfonate) uptake plus vesicular neurotransmitter loading and acidification, distinct from the glutamate-uptake and monoamine transport/metabolism confusables.

qualifier: serotonin and histamine synthesis and uptake with muscarinic receptors
name: Serotonin, histamine and muscarinic signaling with amine metabolism
rationale: Members are serotonin, histamine and muscarinic acetylcholine receptor signalling plus serotonin/histamine synthesis, uptake and secretion; the amine metabolism members distinguish it from tachykinin, cAMP-PDE, adenosine and nicotinic confusables.

name: Glutamate, glutamine and proline amino acid nitrogen metabolism
rationale: Members cover glutamate-family amino acid synthesis and breakdown, 2-oxoglutarate, glycine/glyoxylate, aspartate/asparagine and nitrogen utilization; this glutamate-hub focus separates it from urea cycle, glycine conjugation and alanine/gluconeogenesis confusables.

qualifier: ECM assembly, collagen and myofibroblast control
name: Fibrotic connective tissue replacement and ECM assembly control
rationale: Members regulate fibrosis-type repair through connective tissue replacement, ECM assembly, collagen metabolism, myofibroblast and cardiac fibroblast differentiation and TGF-beta responsiveness, unlike SMAD signalling, miRNA, fibroblast migration and matrix degradation confusables.

core: Neural progenitor proliferation and neuron differentiation
name: Neural progenitor expansion and midbrain-forebrain neuron specification
rationale: Members concern neuroblast/neural stem cell division and maintenance and regional differentiation (midbrain dopaminergic, forebrain patterning, cerebellar precursors); this distinguishes it from sympathetic, radial glia, cortical migration and retinal confusables.

qualifier: sialic acid, GDP-mannose and lysosomal glycan catabolism
name: Sialic acid, mannose and amino sugar metabolism
rationale: Members are sialic acid synthesis/breakdown, GDP-mannose and mannose/fructose-6-phosphate metabolism and lysosomal oligosaccharide catabolism, unlike confusables centred on UDP-GlcNAc, dolichol, GPI and nucleotide-sugar transport.

name: Embryonic limb and craniofacial morphogenesis
rationale: All members are embryonic shaping of limbs/digits and the face, nose and skull, which the pharyngeal-gland, ear and somitogenesis confusables lack.

name: Telomere replication with D-loop and t-circle control
rationale: Members are semi-conservative telomere replication and resolution of telomeric D-loops and t-circles, distinct from fork reversal, C-strand synthesis and telomere capping confusables.

name: Rab and ARF GTPase control of membrane trafficking
rationale: Members are Rab/ARF signalling and TBC RabGAPs with the endocytic, recycling, secretory and Golgi-membrane trafficking steps they govern; the GTPase regulatory layer separates it from Golgi-structure and endosome-route confusables.

name: Folate one-carbon and methionine-SAM cycle metabolism
rationale: Members cover folate transport and THF interconversion, formate, methionine/SAM metabolism and its inherited defects (MTR, MTRR, MAT1A, AHCY), unlike methionine salvage, selenium and choline confusables.

qualifier: AP-1/FOS targets driven by growth signals
name: AP-1 and immediate-early gene response to growth signals
rationale: Members are AP-1/FOSL and NR4A immediate-early gene programmes induced by KRAS, TNF and growth factors with fibroblast proliferation; these transcriptional targets distinguish it from MAPK feedback, UV/PI3K, ARE mRNA decay and JNK/p38 kinase confusables.

name: Heme biosynthesis and cytosolic iron-sulfur cluster assembly
rationale: Members are porphyrin/heme synthesis and its regulation together with mitochondrial ABC exporters and cytosolic Fe-S assembly, which the iron uptake, erythrocyte gas transport and mitochondrial Fe-S confusables lack.

qualifier: integrated stress response and ER unfolded protein response
name: Integrated stress response and ER unfolded protein response
rationale: Members span the eIF2alpha-kinase integrated stress response (HRI, GCN2, PERK translational control), mitochondrial UPR and the ER UPR arms with their apoptotic outputs, distinct from FOXO, protein folding, ER targeting and heat shock confusables.
